relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results support the emerging evidence that anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies may be effective in medication overuse headache patients irrespective of detoxification

relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: hospital admission for abrupt acute medication withdrawal did not influence the effectiveness of anti-CGRP mAbs

key_findings: After 3 months of erenumab/galcanezumab, 59% of MOH patients reverted from MOH and 51% had at least 50% fewer monthly headache days
In-hospital detoxification gave no additional benefit; baseline monthly pain medication intake was the only prognostic factor
